name: LTX-2.3
notes: 22B total (14B video + 5B audio + 3B VAE). Native 4K at 50 FPS. Synchronized stereo audio. Up to 20-second clips. Distilled 8-step variant with FP8 fits 16 GB for 1080p. Open weights Apache 2.0. ComfyUI v0.26.0 adds native LTX2 Context Windows node. GitHub: https://github.com/Lightricks/LTX-Video

name: HunyuanVideo 1.5
vram_requirement: ~8-12 GB (FP8 + CPU T5 offload); ~16 GB (FP8 T5 on GPU)
notes: 8.3B parameters (down from 13B). Selective and Sliding Tile Attention (SSTA). Bilingual text encoding. Tencent Hunyuan Community License (research/personal OK; commercial restricted). GitHub: https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/HunyuanVideo-1.5

name: SAM 3.1
notes: Drop-in checkpoint swap. Object Multiplex: processes up to 16 objects in single forward pass; 7x faster inference at 128 objects; 32 FPS throughput; zero accuracy loss vs SAM 3. Comfy-Org mirror at Comfy-Org/sam3.1. Already referenced in ComfyUI docs.

name: Krea 2 Turbo
notes: New 12B single-stream DiT. Qwen3-VL-4B text encoder. Krea's own VAE. Two variants: Raw (base, fine-tunable) and Turbo (8-step distilled, fast). FP8 Turbo ~12 GB fits RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB. Community commercial license: free for individuals and teams under 50 seats. Day-0 ComfyUI support in v0.26.0. Quantized at Comfy-Org/Krea-2. Technical report: https://www.krea.ai/blog/krea-2-technical-report. ComfyUI blog: https://blog.comfy.org/p/krea-2-open-source-models-are-now

name: Boogu-Image-0.1 (Base + Turbo + Edit)
notes: 10B double-stream MMDiT + Qwen3-VL-8B text encoder + FLUX.1 VAE. Apache 2.0 license. Three variants: Base (quality/diversity), Turbo (3-4 step, photorealism), Edit (instruction-based editing with negative prompt). Native ComfyUI v0.26.0 support via TextEncodeBooguEdit node. Hotfix Jun 24 fixes aspect-ratio artifacts. Strong bilingual text rendering. GitHub: https://github.com/boogu-project/Boogu-Image

name: comfyui-deno-custom-nodes v0.7.62
supersedes: Manual RTX VSR integration; scattered LTX loaders
vram_requirement: Minimal for RTX VSR (Tensor Core based); inherits model VRAM for others
notes: Released Jun 24 2026. Key nodes: (1) RTX Video Super Resolution 2-pass (VSR/Denoise/Deblur/HighBitrate); (2) LTX 2.3 unified model loader (checkpoint/KJ/GGUF); (3) LTX Multi LoRA Loader; (4) LTX tiled spatial upscaler (beta); (5) Wan 2.2 reference video editing; (6) Video A/B compare slider; (7) H.264 inline preview. Windows/NVIDIA RTX only. RTX 5060 Ti fully compatible.

name: LTX Director 2.0
notes: Community node pack. Major 2.0 adds: full timeline editor (trim/split/extend/combine), IC-LoRA track drag-and-drop, Retake Mode (re-generate specific segments), Timeline Save/Load (JSON), sidebar UI overhaul, hotkeys, multi-select. Free/open-source. Adds non-linear editing layer on top of LTX-2.3.

name: HyperSwap 1a/1b/1c (via ComfyUI-ReActor v0.6.2)
notes: Three quality tiers: 1a (speed), 1b (balanced), 1c (high quality). Higher fidelity than inswapper_128.onnx. Now supported in ComfyUI-ReActor v0.6.2 (Apr 25 2026). ReActor v0.6.2 also adds Restore Face Advanced node (selective restoration of swapped faces only). GitHub: https://github.com/Gourieff/ComfyUI-ReActor

name: ComfyUI-TBG-ETUR v1.2.11
supersedes: Standard tiled KSampler / UltimateSDUpscale for Flux2 workflows
vram_requirement: Variable; Low Memory Mode saves 4-10 GB during refinement
notes: Released Jun 13 2026. Key additions in v1.2.11: NVIDIA PiD as dedicated tiled upscaler; Flux 2 / Flux 2 Klein upscaling harness; per-tile CFG/ControlNet/model overrides; Neuro-Generative Tile Fusion for seamless joins; batch image processing; tile-aware color correction; geometry drift correction. Processes up to 200MP. Install via ComfyUI Manager (search 'TBG'). Patreon-gated for some PRO features; GitHub is public.

name: OmniGen2
vram_requirement: ~17 GB native; ~6 GB with CPU offload (slower)
notes: BAAI unified multimodal generation. arXiv 2506.18871 (Jun 23 2026). Supports text-to-image, instruction editing (clothing/action/background), in-context generation with reference subjects. 17 GB baseline exceeds RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB — CPU offload required, which degrades throughput. Monitor for FP8/NVFP4 quantized variants. Training code + weights + LoRA weights released. Community ComfyUI node at github.com/VectorSpaceLab/OmniGen2. arXiv: https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.18871

name: Wan 2.7
vram_requirement: ~24 GB (FP8 T5 on GPU); ~8-12 GB (GGUF + CPU offload)
notes: Open weights on ModelScope (Wan-AI org); not yet on HuggingFace as of Jun 2026. Features: 1080p, 15-20s clips, native audio, instruction editing, first/last frame control, multi-reference. GGUF quantized variants may run on 16 GB with T5 CPU offload — not yet confirmed. Note: Wan 2.3 does NOT exist; series went 2.1 -> 2.2 -> 2.7.

name: Sapiens2 (0.4B)
notes: ICLR 2026 (arXiv 2604.21681). 4 sizes: 0.4B/0.8B/1B/5B. Tasks: pose, body-part segmentation, surface normals, pointmaps, albedo estimation. Improvements: +4 mAP pose, +24.3 mIoU segmentation, 45.6% reduction in normal estimation error. Pretrained on 1B human images at 1K resolution. No ComfyUI node yet. 0.4B-1B sizes fit 16 GB VRAM. GitHub: https://github.com/facebookresearch/sapiens2

name: Hunyuan3D-Omni
notes: arXiv 2509.21245. ControlNet of 3D: inherits Hunyuan3D-2.1 with unified control encoder. Control modes: bounding box, pose (skeletal), point cloud, voxel. 10 GB VRAM confirmed — fits RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB. Open-source weights + code. No ComfyUI node yet. GitHub: https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/Hunyuan3D-Omni

name: ColorFLUX
supersedes: DDColor (FLUX-based diffusion colorizer vs DDColor's CNN)
notes: CVPR 2026 accepted. Framework: structure-color decoupling on FLUX + progressive DPO for color preferences + visual semantic prompts to eliminate old-photo color bias. No public weights as of Jun 26 2026 — paper only. Monitor for code release post-CVPR (typically Jun-Jul 2026). If released, significant DDColor alternative.

name: HiWave
notes: ETH Zurich + Disney Research. arXiv Jun 25 2026. Training-free, zero-shot approach for ultra-high-resolution generation. Two-stage: base image + patch-wise DDIM inversion + wavelet-based detail enhancement. Preferred in >80% of user study comparisons. Code NOT yet released. Plugs into SDXL, Flux, other existing models when released. SIGGRAPH Asia 2025 proceedings.

name: LTX Trainer unified (13 training modes)
notes: Released Jun 17 2026. Unified LTX Trainer now supports 13 modes from single config: T2V, I2V, video extension (fwd/bwd), inpainting, outpainting, T2A, audio extension, audio inpainting, A2V, V2A, IC-LoRA (V2V/A2A/AV2AV). Enables creating character LoRAs, style LoRAs, camera control LoRAs for LTX-2.3. Also ships SKILL.md mentioning Claude Code compatibility. Training tool, not inference upgrade.

name: InfiniDepth
supersedes: Depth Anything V2 for arbitrary-resolution single-image depth
notes: CVPR 2026 (arXiv 2601.03252). Neural implicit field depth representation enabling continuous-coordinate queries at arbitrary resolution. Supplements rather than replaces DA3 (which spellcaster uses). No ComfyUI node. HF Space: https://huggingface.co/papers/2601.03252
